name: ami-pwned
description: Browser extension checking whether a password appears in Have I Been Pwned breaches (k-anonymity).

scripts.dev: npm run clean && (vite build --watch & vite build --watch -c vite.content.config.ts & wait)
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
